summary: Tipperary-born son of Thomas Heffernan and Catherine Boney; brother of John's 3rd-great-grandfather Andrew H. Heffernan.
bio: Richard Heffernan was baptized in County Tipperary, Ireland, on 22 December 1844, a son of Thomas Heffernan and Catherine Boney. He was a brother of Andrew H. Heffernan, John's 3rd-great-grandfather.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
